## Before

What someone using Isotone experiences today, in plain words. Name who that is:
the person reviewing their app, their coding agent, or a maintainer.

## After

What changes for them. If it helps, describe it as something they would do or see.

## Review notes

Only what a reviewer needs to judge this change: risks, trade-offs, effects on
existing users, and what to try in the demo or a project. Leave out file lists
and implementation detail unless they matter here.

## Tested

What was checked, and what wasn't.
